Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Helios POC: sprint status, owners, and next steps

Team / Helios — quick checkpoint update and commitments for the coming week. This consolidates the MAP updates and lists concrete owners/due dates. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary (current status):
- MAP version: Helios_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (attached).
- Engineering ramp: on track pending Splunk endpoint and procurement confirmation.
- Acceptance gate: target signoff window Aug 25–27 (formal signoff on Aug 25, final decision call Aug 27).

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Marissa Cole — Confirm overage/pricing cadence and publish a short billing note into the MAP (due: 2027-08-13, status: PENDING).
2) Helios (Jordan / Sofia) — Provide Splunk HEC endpoint and token OR request S3 export config (due: 2027-08-15, status: REQUESTED).
3) Rishi Malhotra — Push test harness + 10k sample + 50k/day script to internal repo and share curl examples (due: 2027-08-13, status: IN PROGRESS).
4) Kimberly Park — Finalize acceptance checklist and circulate a one-page signoff summary (due: 2027-08-20, status: DRAFT).
5) Legal/Procurement (Helios) — Confirm any contract redlines by Aug 23 so we can preserve Aug 25 signoff (due: 2027-08-23, status: AWAITING).

Acceptance criteria (short list):
- Perf: p95 latency <= 200ms (128-token prompts) across three independent runs.
- Throughput: sustained >= 100 req/s for 5-minute windows without queue growth.
- Security: audit logs exported and verified by Helios; retention >= 90 days.
- Output quality: Helios QA pass rate >= 90% on provided templates.
- Data handling: no customer PII written to public telemetry; KMS-managed keys for any persisted artifacts.

Risks / blockers:
- If Splunk token is not provided by Aug 15 we will need to schedule additional export verification and this will push the signoff by ~3 business days.
- Pending procurement confirmation on overage cadence — if they require per-hour metering we need a pricing addendum and a 48-hour buffer to update billing pipelines.

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1.3.xlsx; eval_criteria_v2.md; latency-benchmark-20270806.csv

Please confirm the Splunk endpoint and procurement stance in replies. If we get those two items by Mon Aug 15 EOD we remain on the Aug 25 acceptance window.

Thanks — Kim
